title: 4 Fair View Terrace, Patrick Street, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91E9K2
seoTitle: 4 Fair View Terrace, Patrick Street, Mullingar, Co. Westmeath, N91E9K2
description:
Egans are delighted to bring this three-bay, mid-terrace, two-storey residence to the open market for sale, c.1850.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, sitting room, living room, kitchen, and bathroom, all located on the ground floor. The first floor offers three spacious double bedrooms.

The property would benefit from modernisation, offering an excellent opportunity for purchasers to refurbish and enhance a character-filled home to their own taste.

Ideally situated on the western side of Mullingar town centre, the property is within minutes’ walking distance of all town centre amenities, including shops, services, and Mullingar Train Station.

Outside, there is a secure south facing rear garden.

The property is a protected structure, listed with Westmeath County Council under Protected Structure Reference No. 019-050. - "A good quality and well-proportioned mid nineteenth-century terraced house, which retains much of its early character and form. The fourth house of an elegant terrace of six."

Please note, there is no parking with this property. A residence parking permit is accessed via Westmeath County Council from approx. €25 per annum.

Viewing of this property is highly recommended with Egans.
